career_ladder.note: Subordinate and field staff across the Union Territory of Ladakh are recruited through the Ladakh Subordinate Services Recruitment Board (LAHDC Leh SSRB / Kargil DSSRB) for district-cadre posts and through the Staff Selection Commission (SSC Selection Posts Ladakh) for UT and divisional cadres. Entry-level subordinate staff are appointed at Pay Level SL-1 (Orderly, Peon, Attendant, Chowkidar, Safaiwala: ₹14,800 - ₹47,100) or Level 2 (Driver Grade-II, Wildlife Guard, Forest Guard: ₹19,900 - ₹63,200). Promotion follows the Ladakh Subordinate Services regulations, progressing to Senior Attendant / Jamadar (Level 2), Daftari / Record Keeper / Junior Assistant under departmental promotion quota (Level 4: ₹25,500 - ₹81,100), Senior Assistant (Level 5: ₹29,200 - ₹92,300), and Office Superintendent / Section Officer (Level 6/7).

exam_scheme.note: Selection for Matric Level posts in the Union Territory of Ladakh is conducted through an OMR-based Written Examination by the Ladakh Subordinate Services Recruitment Board (LAHDC Leh SSRB / Kargil DSSRB) for district cadre posts, and through a Computer Based Examination (CBE) by the Staff Selection Commission (SSC Selection Posts Ladakh) for UT/divisional posts. The written examination carries 100 objective multiple-choice questions across 4 sections: General Intelligence, General Awareness, Quantitative Aptitude (Basic Arithmetic Skills), and English Language (Basics of English Language). LAHD-SSRB allocates 100 marks (1 mark per question, 90 minutes, -0.25 negative marking). SSC allocates 200 marks (2 marks per question, 60 minutes, -0.50 negative marking). A qualifying Skill Test / Trade Test / Physical Endurance Test (e.g. driving skill test for Drivers, 25 km walk in 4 hours for Forest/Wildlife Guards) is conducted where prescribed, followed by Document Verification.

financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated for Level SL-1 entry basic pay (₹14,800) for Orderlies/Attendants and Level 2 (₹19,900) for Drivers/Forest Guards under the 7th CPC pay structure adopted by the UT Administration of Ladakh, with 58% Central DA, 10% HRA (Class Z category for Leh and Kargil), Transport Allowance (₹900 + 58% DA for Level SL-1 / Level 2), and Special Compensatory (Remote Locality) / High Altitude Allowance admissible across Ladakh UT postings. Deductions include 10% employee NPS contribution on Basic + DA and UT Group Insurance.
official_perks: Special Compensatory (Remote Locality) Allowance (SCRLA) / Special Duty Allowance (SDA) for service in high-altitude UT of Ladakh
House Rent Allowance (10% for Class Z areas) or government staff accommodation in Leh / Kargil districts
Transport Allowance (₹900 + 58% DA for Pay Level SL-1 / Level 2)
Winter allowance, heating subsidy, and high altitude clothing/gear allowance where admissible
National Pension System (NPS) defined contribution with 14% government contribution
Medical reimbursement under Central Services (Medical Attendance) Rules, LTC (Leave Travel Concession), and encashable leave

competition_benchmarks.note: Matric-level recruitments in UT Ladakh draw immense participation from local youth across Leh and Kargil districts due to domicile reservation (mandating Ladakh Resident Certificate) and permanent government job security under the 7th CPC pay structure. In the 2025 cycle (Advt No. 01/2025), LAHD-SSRB notified 346 Matric Level vacancies, with 581 candidates shortlisted for counselling and document verification from an estimated applicant pool of ~9,380 candidates.
